method: Targeted web sweep (WebSearch + WebFetch, ~57 tool calls, 2026-09-27). Priority: the 6 pre-flagged sites, then eThekwini transit camps, Cape Town TRAs/emergency sites, Nelson Mandela Bay, Buffalo City, KSD/Mthatha, Johannesburg/Tshwane. Queries combined site names (and local names) with flood/flooded/water/rain/stormwater, plus municipality-level 'transit camp flooded' / 'TRA flooded' queries and city-wide flood-event coverage (Cape Town Jul 2025, May 2026; eThekwini Apr 2022, Feb 2025; Buffalo City Jun 2026). Included only flooding/water ingress/stormwater damage at the relocation site itself after people lived there; excluded the displacing flood. Quotes are copied as returned by page fetches; where a page could not be fetched (403) this is noted and confidence lowered. Sites not listed in found or not_found_ids were not searched individually in this pass (see not_searched_ids).

found.flood_date: Repeated events before May 2022 ('four to five' significant floods reported by 25 May 2022); flooding still cited July 2023
found.what: Camp between a river and a highway floods when heavy rain makes the water level rise and overflow; possessions lost to water; a resident died after tripping on live wiring while emptying floodwater.
found.quote: When there are heavy rains, the water level rises and overflows and our homes get flooded.

found.what: Resident relocated out of the Isipingo TEA refers to people left behind still experiencing flooding there.
found.quote: I couldn't sleep comfortably knowing that some people are still experiencing the cold weather and the flooding [at the TEA].

found.what: Residents moved in March 2021 (after 2019 Mega Village floods); units flooded in the April 2022 deluge and residents fled to nearby hostel halls, then were ordered back. Camp is low-lying near the Umlaas Canal.
found.quote: the units flooded during the recent deluge, residents were forced to flee to the nearby hostel halls

found.site: eMathinini / Gwala Street transit camp, Lamontville
found.what: Flash flood on the canal bank killed people living in the transit camp, including three children. Search snippets of IOL (26 Feb 2025; page returned 403) name the camp as the 'Gwala Street Transit Camp'; the MEC quote below confirms the victims lived in a transit camp on the canal bank. This is the Feb 2025 event currently attached to id 33 in the source CSV.
found.quote: The people who lost their lives were in a transit camp where they were moved to that camp after the 2022 floods.

found.flood_date: 2022 floods (resident moved into a community hall); recurrent whenever it rains (reported 21 Sep 2023)
found.what: Low-lying camp (established 2017) where rainwater enters the houses; residents moved into a community hall during the 2022 floods.
found.quote: The area is low lying and when it rains water goes into the houses.

found.flood_date: January 2024 (reported 9-12 Jan 2024; further flooding reported 31 Jan-2 Feb 2024)
found.what: Usindiso fire survivors moved to Denver in Nov 2023; summer rains flooded their shacks, soaking beds, clothes, food and documents; no drainage on site; residents dug their own stormwater channels.
found.quote: The water seeps in. When it rains, water also comes in from the cracks in the roof.

found.flood_date: c. May 2023 ('recent rains', article dated 16 May 2023)
found.what: Resident of a government-allocated NU30 bungalow (promised a house since 2020) says heavy rain flooded the bungalow floor. Article does not explicitly label it the Covid TRU scheme, hence medium.
found.quote: The recent rains were so heavy that they flooded the floor of the bungalow. We literally swam in it.

found.what: Rainwater enters structures from below; City responded to flooding issues at the emergency site during winter.
found.quote: My roof was leaking, water would come in from the bottom of the structure when it rains.

found.what: City Disaster Risk Management listed Kampies among the hardest-hit flooded settlements in the May 2026 cold fronts. (Daily Maverick 6 Jul 2025 also reports 50 homes flooded in 'Strandfontein's Kampies settlement'.) Assumed to be the same City-run site; not explicitly identified as the emergency housing site.
found.quote: flooding reported in informal settlements including Island, Makhaza and Monwabisi in Khayelitsha, Imizamo Yethu, Nomzamo, Lwandle, Phola Park, Gugulethu, Valhalla Park, Vygieskraal, Tafelsig, Delft and Kampies.

found.what: Blocked stormwater drains leave water running in the streets; residents move beds and furniture to avoid leaks when it rains.
found.quote: The stormwater drains are blocked and water runs in the streets.

found.site: KwaDabeka transit camp ('Lindelani 1 transit camp in KwaDabeka')
found.flood_date: c. late Oct/early Nov 2023 (statement dated 6 Nov 2023)
found.what: DA statement says prefab units face collapse after heavy rains. Rain damage rather than documented inundation; political statement, not reporting.
found.quote: prefab housing faces collapse following recent heavy rains

found.what: Resident says the temporary units, placed without a survey, flood when it rains. Unclear how many units were occupied at the time (454 of 633 built).
found.quote: when it's raining they get flooded. They should have called a surveyor

notes: Checks on the existing reflood_documented flags: id 26 CONFIRMED; id 32 CONFIRMED (Apr 2022) and the Feb 2025 Lamontville deaths also belong here (Gwala Street camp); id 59 CONFIRMED. id 2 (Delft TRA 5, 'flooding reported Jul 2026') NOT CONFIRMED: Delft was among flooded areas in the 11 May 2026 storm (GroundUp, Daily Maverick) but no source names TRA 5/6, and nothing found for July 2026. id 13 (Sondela) NOT CONFIRMED and probably misread: the 'flood-prone wetland' in News24 (22 Feb 2023) describes the ORIGINAL Sondela settlement people were moved FROM, not the new TRA. id 33 (Lamontville/Barcelona 2) NOT CONFIRMED as a separate site: the Feb 2025 flood is documented at the Gwala Street transit camp (= id 32); suggest moving that flag to id 32 unless Barcelona 2 is confirmed to be the same camp. Excluded: id 10 Stock Road/Bhekela, where heavy-rain pooling was pumped out in Oct 2023 during site preparation, BEFORE the Dec 2023 moves (PMG 11 Oct 2023); later coverage (DM 7 Aug 2025) mentions only leaking taps causing 'small floods' and muddy puddles. id 73 Van Rooyen TRUs: the Oct 2024 Kariega flood hit before the 29 Oct 2024 move, and the Jan 2026 coverage mentions no flooding. id 8 Wolwerivier: Aug 2023 landspout caused WIND damage (42 structures damaged), not flooding; a search-engine summary about water seeping into floors could not be traced to a fetched article. id 18 Imizamo Yethu: flooded May 2026, but only the wider settlement is named, not the TRAs. id 77/78 Buffalo City: June 2026 flooding at the Ntilini informal settlement in Ziphunzana, not the TRUs. id 28 Amaoti: leaking roofs/pipes only, no flooding. id 80 Mayden Farm, 81 Pola Park: nothing post-move found. Victims are not named. Suggested follow-up: fetch IOL 26 Feb 2025 (403 here) to get a verbatim 'Gwala Street Transit Camp' quote, News24/Daily Sun Jan 2024 Denver pieces, and run individual searches on the not_searched_ids (especially the eThekwini TEAs 42-55, KwaDukuza 56 and Kariega 75-76).
